newsitem.title: UK: Tullow Oil farms out part of Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Tullow Oil farms out part of Egypt.

text.p: Irish exploration group Tullow Oil Plc said on Thursday it had arranged, subject to government approval, to farm out part of its interest in the onshore North Abu Rudeis Block in Egypt.
Tullow will remain operator with a 33.3 percent interest. Royal Dutch/Shell Group's Shell Egypt and Canada's Cabre Exploration Ltd will now also hold one-third shares.
The North Abu Rudeis permit on the east bank of the Gulf of Suez was signed in January 1997.

Extensive infrastructure is already in place. The block is adjacent to major oil storage and loading facilities for Gulf of Suez, allowing development of any discoveries to be quickly achieved, Tullow said in a statement.
A well will be drilled in the third quarter of 1997.
